lines: Hot today, ah? Should've brought an umbrella.
You new around here? Kota Damansara is the best lah.
The pasar malam opens tonight. Their satay is shiok!
My cousin got a Mythic from the Capsule Machine. Lucky fella.
Traffic on the highway again... better to cycle, I tell you.
Gergasi is having a sale. Cheaper than ordering online!
Kilat Car Wash is always looking for helpers. Easy money.
Have you eaten? Makan dulu, then hustle.
They say the Lucky Strand Casino opens soon. Wah, exciting.
Saving up for a condo at Ant Palms. One day, one day...
If you see someone selling nasi lemak at night, buy one for me!
The footbridge over the highway saves so much time.
Don't forget to claim your daily reward, ah.
I heard the Mall Mystery Box gives wings. Wings!
Walk under the flyover, it's nice and shady.

errands.ask: Aiyo, my parcel is waiting at {place}. Can you collect it for me? I'll pay you {reward}!
errands.pickup: 📦 Picked up the parcel. Now bring it back to {npc}.
errands.thanks: Wah, my parcel! Terima kasih banyak. Here, for your trouble.

errands.ask: I left my umbrella at {place}! Could you go get it? {reward} for you.
errands.pickup: ☂️ Found the umbrella. Take it back to {npc}.
errands.thanks: My umbrella! You're a lifesaver. Ambil ni.

errands.ask: I'm dying for a teh tarik... can you ask them at {place} to pack one for me? I'll pay {reward}.
errands.pickup: 🥤 Got the teh tarik. Bring it to {npc} before it gets cold!
errands.thanks: Ahhh, perfect. Still warm some more. Thank you!

errands.ask: Help me drop these flyers at {place}, boleh? Then come tell me. {reward}!
errands.thanks: Done already? Fast! Here's your pay.
